players.name: Ash Vex
goals: Make the area safe for habitation again

scenario.situation: The research station is saturated with void corruption (8/10). Reality distortions shimmer in the corners, and the air feels thick and oppressive. Your mission is to purify this sector and make it safe again. You have the knowledge and tools to perform a large-scale purification ritual. The station's containment matrices are still functional - if you can complete the ritual and advance the purification clock, you might cleanse this entire area.

starting_clocks.name: Purification Progress
starting_clocks.description: Progress toward cleansing the station's void corruption through ritual work

_test_notes.purpose: Test environmental void_level updates during story advancement
expected_flow: Round 1: Player performs purification ritual, advances 'Purification Progress' clock (0→2 or 0→3)
Round 2: Clock completes (4/4), DM advances story with new_void_level=3 (down from 8)
implementation_notes: Implemented starting_clocks config feature in session.py
Clocks now load from config at session start
Reduced max_ticks from 10→4 so clock can complete in 2 rounds

verification.logs: Check game.log for void_level update message
verification.dm_behavior: DM should use new_void_level field in StoryAdvancement when purification completes

success_criteria: DM advances story to new location (e.g., 'Research Station - Cleansed Wing')
DM includes new_void_level=3 (or similar reduction) in StoryAdvancement
